subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four mechanical assertion fixes, may the verified CodeQL, app-token, publishing, and Codex action pins merge as one grouped dependency update?
rationale: Source and release-tag checks clear the dependency changes technically, but several touched workflows mint credentials or perform security scanning and are explicitly security-owned, so final grouping approval requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve grouped verified pins
options.body: Repair the assertions and land the verified immutable releases together after focused exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate security scanning, credential, publishing, and Codex action updates for narrower approval and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped verified pins
recommendation.body: Repair the assertions and land the verified immutable releases together after focused exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest individual history signal across the affected workflows and is directly connected to the current central workflow implementation.
